landmarks.name: Lalbagh Fort (Fort Aurangabad)
landmarks.highlights: Tomb of Pari Bibi, Lalbagh Mosque, Subahdar Diwan-i-Aam, subterranean water canals.

landmarks.name: Ahsan Manzil (The Pink Palace)
landmarks.highlights: Former official residential palace and seat of the Nawab of Dhaka on the banks of Buriganga River, now a national museum.
